report_sections_required: Select at least one report section
no_api_key: AI key not set: add it in Settings → “AI assistant”
unsupported_type: This file type is not supported
provider: The AI provider returned an error
pending_not_found: Draft not found, upload the file again
nothing_to_parse: Attach the imaging report (PDF or photo) or paste the text
not_pdf: The file does not look like a PDF
sample_no_text: This PDF has no text, it looks like a scan. A sample needs a PDF the lab emailed or posted in its online account.
samples_off: Sending samples is not set up
sample_send_failed: The sample was not sent. Try again later or copy the text
no_results: No lab results for this month
no_milestone: This study has no milestone for attachments
no_dicom: Images for this study have not been imported
meta_files_mismatch: The file descriptions do not match the files
password_required: Confirm the change with your MedControl password
ingestion_failed: Format not recognized and no AI key is set
in_use: This entry is in use and cannot be deleted
egress: No internet access through the proxy
bad_question: The question is empty or too long
ai_empty: The model found no lab results in the document
timeout: The service did not respond in time (AI or parser), try again later
no_samples: The request contains no recognized health metrics
no_text_layer: This PDF has no text layer (scan): click “Extract text” and the scan will be read without AI
ocr_failed: Could not read the file: it may be damaged, or it is not a scan or photo
no_passkeys: No passkeys added, sign in with a password
passkey_challenge: Time ran out, start signing in again
passkey_unknown: This passkey is not registered in MedControl
agent_not_found: Infusion or injection medication not found
setup_needed: Complete the first-run setup first: set a password
setup_done: First-run setup is already complete, sign in with your password
weak_password: Password is too simple. It needs at least 10 characters, not digits only, not a keyboard or alphabet run and not a common password like “password2024”
set_in_env: This value is set in .env: change it there and restart gateway
bad_token: This does not look like a bot token. A token looks like 123456789:AA…
bad_chat_id: Chat ID is a number, for example 123456789
bad_key: The key must have no spaces and be at most 300 characters
same_password: The new password is the same as the current one
bad_ref_range: Invalid reference range: at least one limit must be a number, and the lower limit cannot exceed the upper one
model_no_files: The selected AI service cannot see images, and no text could be read from the file. OpenRouter, Anthropic, or ChatGPT can read images and photos without text (Settings → “AI assistant”)
bad_base_url: The address must start with http:// or https://, for example http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1
bad_folder: Yandex Cloud folder ID: Latin letters and digits, for example b1g2abcdefgh
mcp_disabled_by_admin: Access for AI agents is disabled by the server administrator (DTC_MCP=off)
mcp_ack_required: To turn on access, confirm that you have read the data protection warning
mcp_off: Turn on access for AI agents first
mcp_too_many_tokens: No more than 10 active tokens: revoke the ones you don't need
too_many_requests: Too many requests, wait a minute
server_only: Available only in the server version of MedControl
import_not_empty: An archive can only be loaded into a new installation with no entries. This one already has data: loading does not merge or overwrite it
import_bad_archive: This is not a MedControl full data archive (Settings → Full data archive → Download archive)
invalid_recovery_code: The recovery code did not work. Make sure it is the latest code issued: the code changes after each password reset
no_recovery_code: No recovery code was created on this installation, so the password cannot be reset with a code. If you remember the password, sign in and create a code in Settings → “Sign-in and security”
invalid_setup_code: The first-run code did not work. It is in the server log: docker compose logs gateway | grep SETUP_CODE
setup_busy: Setup is already being saved, wait a couple of seconds
bad_dose_no: No such dose for the day: check how many times a day the medication is taken
bad_birth_date: Date of birth cannot be in the future or before 1900
bad_time: Time must be in HH:MM format, for example 09:30
repeat_before_first: The repeat must be later than the first reminder
bad_lab_stale_days: Number of days must be from 7 to 180
bad_output: The model returned an answer that could not be read
too_big: The file is too big for the model
unsupported_file: This format cannot be read yet. Use a PDF, a photo or a text file
no_text_in_file: No text found in the file
